opening.argument: The offer is an audience-engagement contest built around guessing the hosts' ethnic background, with Amazon gift cards offered as the reward. Viewers are asked to subscribe, view the referenced Ancestry DNA material, and post their guess in the comments, while the winner is determined by the closest percentage guess without going over. The participation requirements described here involve ordinary channel engagement and a comment, with no stated demand for payment or private credentials. The speaker also says the card will be provided during the results video, but the available records do not establish whether the gift cards were ultimately distributed.

citations.quote: We are giving away $30.00 amazon gift cards
to those who subscribe to our channel
all you have to do is guess where we're from.
whoever comes closest to the percentage without going over
We'll get the card when we do our result video.
